summary: The agent successfully establishes a sequential train/validation split and correctly sets up a LightGBM regressor. However, the solution suffers from data leakage because it imputes missing values in the validation and test sets using their own respective means rather than the training set mean. Furthermore, the agent skips feature engineering, relies on a single stochastic evaluation with one metric, and blindly passes raw columns to the model without ensuring categorical string features are encoded.
